chapters.label: The wonder goal, live
chapters.text: Sydney, the 2023 World Cup semi-final. England lead one-nil. Sam Kerr gets the ball in her own half, and runs! She splits two defenders... and shoots from outside the box. Goal!

chapters.label: Drive at them
chapters.text: Watch it again. Kerr drives straight at the defenders. They back away, so she keeps going, right between them.

chapters.label: Before the keeper is set
chapters.text: Then she shoots early, before Mary Earps is set. It flies over her... One-all!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Drive at defenders to push them back. Shoot early, while the keeper is still moving. Lock your ankle and strike through the ball.
